stated_limitation: We do not have layer annotations, so we select the channel with the highest theta (5-11 Hz) to delta (1-4 Hz) power ratio, computed from a 200 s window in the middle of the maze epoch.

justification.dataset: 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-maze session is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta entrainment, an expert-standard choice.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, LFP correctly converted, spikes restricted to running bouts with an explicit >=100-spike criterion and cell-type metadata used directly.
justification.analysis: Correct circular statistics (MRL, Rayleigh, preferred phase) applied to spike-theta phase with a time-shift null, exactly the appropriate treatment.
justification.correctness: Every reported number (103/136, 87/119, 16/17, median MRL 0.116 vs shuffle 0.025, MW p=1.5e-4) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Polar histograms, population summary, pooled phase, and cycle-by-cycle trace all show the effect clearly with units, sample sizes, and examples ranked by MRL (the effect strength itself).
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and nothing is misrepresented, but the write-up states no result-level limitation (single session, trivially-significant high-count interneurons), capping a genuinely clean result at a minor fault.
justification.verdict: A clean, reproducible, methodologically sound demonstration of theta phase entrainment that a supervisor would accept and move on from.
